mechanism: Phenobarbital induces hepatic metabolism of amphotericin B (though amphotericin B is primarily metabolized via non-enzymatic pathways), and concurrent use increases risk of nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities through additive renal effects.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), and amphotericin B efficacy closely; consider alternative anticonvulsant if possible or use liposomal amphotericin B formulation to minimize nephrotoxicity.
